Open the [bulk-label prototype](http://maker:4001/search.html?mode=live&bulk=mode&bulkActions=labels).

1. Enter **Select items** mode.
2. Select the potato and Kyoto bookmarks.
3. Choose **Add label**, select **Work**, and apply it.

Both cards should retain their original labels and also gain **Work**.

I’ve assumed the selection remains active after applying a label, so you can perform another batch action or explicitly choose **Done selecting**. Please check whether that continuation feels right.
